first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, so simplifying the onboarding flow is the most directly aligned intervention and has prior evidence of improving time-to-value and first-week activation. Verify both the onboarding-shortening and signup-field-reduction records to determine which lever is most appropriate. Run a guarded test and measure qualified pipeline/revenue, not just completion or activation, because downstream value is not yet established.
